note: 3 controls, each with a failure probe; separate from the 40-case run and not mixed into it (own denominator)

checks.claim: A correctly signed evidence record for a benign action_narrow call is admitted and the M2-auth gate completes the call.
checks.check: AuthenticatedEvidenceGate.evaluate_signed on action_narrow-0-b (read_public) with an HMAC-signed apc_state record, then gate.receipt.
checks.failure_control: same record with evidence_signature removed -> must be rejected before admission

reasons: evidence record carries no signature field

checks.not_claimed: does not test key management, freshness/nonces across time, or asymmetric verification; the key is a public test constant

checks.claim: A field changed after signing (apc_allowed false -> true) is rejected by the signature check before admission.
checks.check: AuthenticatedEvidenceGate.evaluate_signed on action_narrow-0-a (send_external, shadow-denied) with a record mutated after signing.
checks.failure_control: unmutated signed record on the same call: the signature must verify (no signature code) and admission must then fail on the apc_allowed obligation

reasons: evidence not admitted (apc_state record failed its rule)

checks.not_claimed: does not test mutation of every field; the probe shows the rejection is caused by the post-signing mutation, not by a blanket failure

checks.claim: A validly signed record from a different call is rejected by the binding check (same signature, wrong call).
checks.check: AuthenticatedEvidenceGate.evaluate_signed on action_narrow-0-a (send_external) with the record signed for action_narrow-1-b (read_public).

reasons: signed record tool='read_public' does not match the call ('send_external')

checks.failure_control: the same record presented for its original call (action_narrow-1-b) must be admitted, showing the rejection is binding-specific
checks.not_claimed: does not test replay within a time window (no freshness/nonce beyond the call binding) or cross-process replay
